references.text: The Lord establishes Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, which is a precursor to the events described in Mark 14:1.
David speaks prophetically about betrayal by a close friend, reflecting the plans to capture Jesus with deceit.
Daniel prophesies about a time when sacrifice and grain offering will cease, corresponding to the period around Jesus' death.
Jesus Himself mentions that Passover is two days away and that He will be handed over to be crucified, directly related to Mark 14:1.
Luke also describes Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, as well as the plans of the chief priests and scribes, parallel to Mark 14:1.
John mentions the people's expectation and the leaders' plans to arrest Jesus during the Passover festival, which is relevant to Mark 14:1.
